sim.heading: Simulate it
sim.caption: The database only ever sees the cache misses, so a good hit rate is the cheapest capacity there is. At the defaults it receives about 29 requests a second of the 200 offered and is about 22% busy.
steps: Leave the controls alone and read the database utilisation: about 22%, steady.
Set the cache hit rate to 0.3 and wait ten seconds.
The database saturates at 100% busy and about 4% of requests start to fail.
Put the hit rate back to 0.85 and raise the offered load to 1200: the database saturates again, this time from volume.
At 1200 a second, a hit rate of 0.95 brings the database back to about 46% busy.
